description: This file defines the Java entity class 'LoanDelinquencyTagHistory' which models the history of delinquency tags associated with loans in the Fineract system. It includes fields for delinquency range, associated loan, added and lifted dates, and supports persistence via JPA annotations.

classes.name: LoanDelinquencyTagHistory
classes.description: Entity class that tracks the history of delinquency tags for loans, including when tags are added or lifted.

methods.description: Constructor initializing the delinquency range, loan, added date, and lifted date.
